\label{lemma-cohomology-is-zero}
Assumptions and notation as in
Proposition \ref{proposition-compute-cohomology}.
Then
$$
H^j(\text{Cris}(X/S), \mathcal{F} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_{X/S}} \Omega^i_{X/S})
= 0
$$
for all $i > 0$ and all $j \geq 0$.
